newsitem.title: FRANCE: French gvt calls for GAN head to resign.
newsitem.headline: French gvt calls for GAN head to resign.

text.p: The French government called on Monday for the resignation of Jean-Jacques Bonnaud, chairman of state-owned insurer GAN, a finance ministry spokeswoman said.

It made the call after its suspension last week of the privatisation of GAN banking unit CIC. Finance Minister Jean Arthuis attacked the heads of both CIC and GAN at the time for failing to help with the privatisation.

"The government has asked for the resignation of Mr Jean-Jacques Bonnaud," the spokeswoman said.
A source close to the issue said the new chairman of GAN would then name a new head for CIC, replacing Bernard Yoncourt.

Despite the cancellation last week of the sale, which ran into stiff opposition from staff and local politicians, Arthuis said CIC would still be privatised at a later date. GAN, is also slated for privatisation.
The government received only two bids for CIC because of a lengthy list of conditions attached to the sale. France's privatisation commission had favoured an offer from Banque Nationale de Paris.
